# iru_blueprint_routing (Data Source)

Reads tenant-wide Blueprint routing manual enrollment settings. The code is sensitive and remains in Terraform state. Does not read routing rules.

The logical `id` is `tenant`. This lookup makes only the documented GET request.
Treat the resulting state as sensitive because it includes the enrollment code.

## Example Usage


```terraform
data "iru_blueprint_routing" "current" {}
```


<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `enrollment_active` (Boolean) Current manual enrollment activation setting.
- `enrollment_code` (String, Sensitive) Current manual enrollment code. Stored in Terraform state.
- `id` (String) Logical singleton identifier: tenant.
